entries.title: XP across all question practice
entries.summary: Previously unscored questions now earn XP in revision and submitted mock exams as well as Past Paper and AI practice. XP is awarded once per question across sections. Answer feedback shows earned, already awarded, or pending XP, and queued answers retry automatically.

entries.title: AI answers for ungraded student-bank questions
entries.summary: Completed 79 previously ungraded student-bank entries with clearly labelled AI-based answers. Where context or choices were missing, complete AI-adapted practice versions now include the original wording for comparison. Formative questions remain unchanged.

entries.title: AI practice now covers every study-guide topic
entries.summary: Added 255 questions across the 17 previously empty topics, bringing AI practice to 1,564 questions across all 106 study-guide topics. Each new topic has 15 questions with clinical applications and mechanism questions. Reference-backed practice is clearly identified where course slides are unavailable. Existing questions and saved progress IDs are preserved.

entries.title: Clearer dark mode, custom icons and safer resets
entries.summary: Dark mode now keeps controls and supporting text readable. In Profile, tap your icon to choose 1–3 letters and a color, or upload a photo. Reset progress now explains exactly what will be erased and kept, with a Cancel option before anything changes.

entries.title: Quiz 2 CVS test bank added; past papers organized
entries.summary: Imported and reviewed all 308 entries from the CVS Module 2 test bank. Duplicate questions share source links and repetition counts. Clear key errors corrected; ambiguous or incomplete recalls remain ungraded. Quiz 2 is organized into Formative, Physiology Important, RS test bank and CVS test bank; Formative and Physiology Important question records are unchanged.

entries.title: Pulmonary hypertension answer aligned with lecture
entries.summary: Formative Quiz 2 Q16 now follows female Pulmonary Vascular Disease slide 3: pulmonary arterial pressure of 25 mmHg or more at rest. Option C is 25 mmHg; wording and explanation match the lecture.

entries.title: Quiz 2 duplicate questions merged
entries.summary: Merged 184 duplicate Quiz 2 cards into 152 retained cards. Repetition tags count source appearances, including the first. Original source links and saved progress are preserved. Quiz 1 is unchanged.
